text:
ara: Heads-up — customer flagged a p99 regression after we aliased /v1/generate -> /v1/text/generate. Dashboard shows service-level p99 up ~120ms but per-endpoint p99s diverge.
jon: Do we know if the tdigest merge semantics changed when we added route aliasing?
maia: Divergent tails are expected if distributions are different. The problem is the UI hides per-endpoint counts, so the rollup looks scary.
kevin: Backend note: we keep tdigest per-route and merge by count-weighting at query time. Frontend was showing the merged number without context.
ara: I pulled the dashboard query — it's basically:
```
SELECT merge_tdigest(tdigest) AS merged FROM latency_sketches
WHERE service = 'inference' AND time >= now() - 1h
GROUP BY service
```
jon: Yup. Also the endpoint breakdown toggle only displays avg/median; it doesn't surface p95/p99 with sample size. UX gap.
maia: Proposal: change the default endpoint panel to show p50/p95/p99 + sample_count. Add a small "rollup semantics" pill: count-weighted vs route-weighted vs raw.
kevin: Implementation caveats: merging many small tdigest sketches is fine but sampling bias appears when traces are sampled per-route. We should expose "effective_sample_size" so users see confidence.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/telemetry-fix started by @maia — build 4821 queued :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ara: Also recommend we tag telemetry with original_route when aliasing to preserve historical per-endpoint series.
jon: Edge-case: ensure deterministic sketch seed and compression params so percentiles are comparable across rollups and over time.
maia: API idea: add query param ?merge=atomic|count_weighted|raw to let console pick semantics.
kevin: I'll open a backend PR for the param + include effective_sample_size in the response. Will add a small frontend change to show the badge and counts. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
ara: For the short term, can we add a chart annotation: "Percentiles may differ across endpoints after aliasing"? Customer asks for explanation ASAP.
jon: Also let's create a regression alert: if p99 for any endpoint > 2x baseline after aliasing, page eng-oncall.
maia: On it. :thumbsup:
kevin: FYI I'll include a unit test that exercises merging two very different distributions to catch mis-merges.
ara: Thanks — loop back once PRs are up and we'll update the dashboard copy/docs.
